subject: english
title: Unit 9 Project App — Make a Thaumatrope
subtitle: Vocab Foundations + Be the Expert + Predict & Prepare + Build It + Share & Rubric + Now I Can + Final Quiz. 8 modules.

content: Predict how a thaumatrope works before building it, then check the prediction.
Put the six build steps in order, including the upside-down flip at step 4.
Explain the optical illusion using cause and effect.
Self-assess the project against the four project-check criteria and the three Unit 9 Now I Can questions.
language: Use the academic word research to talk about finding things out.
Use upside down, attach, combine, thaumatrope, optical illusion, and predict in context.
Explain with because, so, and the double comparative the more… the more…
Ask for and offer help in English while building.
